rules.function_content_separation: UI and rendering capability must not depend on completeness of visual content; content may be added, replaced or removed without changing the learning flow.
rules.no_new_medical_owner: This registry binds already-reviewed visual cues to physical source objects only; it does not create or replace canonical medical content.
rules.fail_closed: A declared required asset that is missing or hash-drifted must fail validation/build rather than render an unverified substitute.
rules.recall_guard: Visual placement and Reveal timing remain owned by the existing learner projection; this registry grants no new render timing.
